summary:
AI-agent orchestration framework landscape vs our product (task-graph orchestrator for Claude Code: DAG of tasks w/ statuses + typed/context/ghost edges, background-subagent dispatch w/ two-tier context handoff, live SSE dashboard, MCP server, default-on PreToolUse hook gate + UserPromptSubmit router, bearer auth, multi-workspace).

PER-TOOL ONE-LINERS:
- LangGraph (+LangSmith): The 800-lb gorilla. Cyclic graph/state-machine runtime (nodes+edges, supports loops, unlike pure DAGs); strong durable state via checkpointers (Postgres/Sqlite), interrupt()-based HITL pause/resume, time-travel debug. LangSmith = mature trace/eval/observability dashboard. It's a LIBRARY for building one agent app's control flow, not a daemon that governs a human dev's editing across tasks. Overlap: graph model, HITL, persistence. Diff from us: no hook-level enforcement on a human's tool calls, no cross-workspace ghost edges, not Claude-Code-native.
- CrewAI: Role-based ("crews" of agents w/ roles/goals/backstory, sequential or hierarchical manager-delegate) + "Flows" (event-driven structured workflows, sequential/parallel/conditional, state mgmt). Big enterprise traction (claims 60% F500). Orchestration model is ROLES not DAG-of-work-items. No hook enforcement, no human-dev-in-the-loop editing gate.
- Microsoft AutoGen/AG2: Conversation-centric — GroupChat w/ a manager/speaker-selector deciding who talks next. AG2 = community fork; v0.4 event-driven async rewrite. Official successor = Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF): executors wired into a directed GRAPH via workflow builder, sequential/fan-out/fan-in/conditional, checkpointing+hydration, HITL via RequestInfoEvent/ToolApprovalRequest pause-resume, durable hosts. MAF is the most DAG+durable+HITL-complete enterprise entrant. Still a build-your-app SDK, not a dev-workflow governor.
- OpenAI Agents SDK (ex-Swarm): Lightweight handoff model — Agents/Handoffs/Guardrails/Tracing. Decentralized peer handoffs, NOT a graph/DAG. Built-in tracing dashbo
